title: Point-slope and standard form
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.lin.forms.point-slope: y − y₁ = m(x − x₁): distribute the m into both terms, then move the number on the y side across.
hints.lin.forms.standard: For an intercept, set the other letter to 0. For the slope or y = mx + b, get y alone: move the x term, then divide every term by the number in front of y.
hints.lin.forms: Every form can become y = mx + b: distribute (point-slope) or get y alone (standard form).

misconceptionMessages.lin.ps-distribute: Multiply the slope into BOTH terms in the parentheses: 2(x − 1) = 2x − 2.
misconceptionMessages.lin.ps-sign: To get y alone from y − 4, ADD 4 to both sides (do the opposite).
misconceptionMessages.lin.std-intercept-swap: For the x-intercept, y is 0: cover up the y term and divide C by the number in front of x.
misconceptionMessages.lin.std-sign: Moving the x term to the other side changes its sign: 2x + y = 5 becomes y = −2x + 5.
misconceptionMessages.lin.std-not-divided: Divide EVERY term by the number in front of y, the x term and the number.
misconceptionMessages.lin.std-slope-a: In Ax + By = C the number in front of x isn't the slope. Get y alone first (slope = −A/B).

sections.title: Point-slope form
sections.objective: Change y − 4 = 2(x − 1) to y = mx + b, and use a slope and a point.
explain: Point-slope form y − y₁ = m(x − x₁) shows the slope m and a point (x₁, y₁) on the line.
It's handy when you know a slope and one point. Turn it into y = mx + b by distributing and moving the number.
sections.key: y − y₁ = m(x − x₁): slope m through (x₁, y₁). Distribute m into both terms, then move the y-side number across.

sections.title: Standard form
sections.objective: Find the intercepts and slope of 2x + 3y = 12, and write it as y = mx + b.
explain: Standard form is Ax + By = C. The intercepts are quick: set the other letter to 0.
For the slope, get y alone: it becomes y = mx + b.
sections.key: Intercepts: set the other letter to 0 and divide. Slope: get y alone (move the x term, then divide every term by the number in front of y).

worked.note: move the x term: its sign changes

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.key: Point-slope: distribute, then move the number. Standard: get y alone, dividing every term.
